<!--
A longtable inside a float never emits the material \endlastfoot marks, and
every table in this format goes in a float. So a pandoc table lost the
\bottomrule that closes it and a flextable lost its note row -- silently, with
no warning from LaTeX -- in manuscript, student and document modes. Journal
mode escaped it only because a longtable refuses two columns there and was
already being set as a tabular.

Every mode sets them as tabulars now. The raw table below stands in for
flextable, which is what writes a longtable with a footer of its own.
-->

# Method

A longtable with a head that repeats and a foot of its own.

```{=latex}
\begin{longtable}[]{@{}ll@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
HEADMARKER & HEADTWO \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endfirsthead
\toprule\noalign{}
HEADMARKER & HEADTWO \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{FOOTMARKER} \\
\endlastfoot
ROWONE & r1 \\
ROWTWO & r2 \\
\end{longtable}
```

Text after the table.
